<div class="card-body">
'''Han's Dice''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].







<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ハンのサイコロ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">戦闘で、戦闘運命数を引いた時に使う。自分の能力値２以上のキャラクターが参加していないと使えない。１フォース消費して、引いた戦闘運命数をキャンセルし、新しい戦闘運命数を引ける。</span>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ミレニアム・ファルコンのコクピットには、お守りに一組のサイコロが吊してある。「全てを操る万能なるフォースなんてものには、お目にかかったことがねえ。」</span>''
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Han's dice.

'''Card text:''' Use when a battle destiny is drawn in battle. You cannot use it unless one of your characters with ability 2 or more is participating. Spend 1 Force to cancel the battle destiny just drawn and draw a new battle destiny.

'''Lore:''' A pair of dice hangs in the Millennium Falcon's cockpit as a good-luck charm. ‘I've never encountered an all-powerful Force that controls everything.’

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese requires one of your participating characters to have ability 2 or more; the English requires ability greater than 2. The Japanese says to cancel the drawn battle destiny and draw a new one; the English says to draw another instead of the one just drawn.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Han's Dice]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
